_comment: UNATTENDED / DAEMON PROFILE. Use this shape ONLY for an agent that runs with no human present - a scheduled job, a message-poller, a background worker. For an agent a human sits in front of, use settings.template.json instead. The defining difference is the empty 'ask' array; see the note below.
_why_ask_is_empty: With no human present, an 'ask' rule is not a prompt - it is a wall. The turn stops, nothing answers it, and the job fails or hangs. Worse, it fails in a way that looks like the agent being unable to do the task rather than being blocked on consent. So an unattended profile has no middle tier: every action is either allowed outright or denied outright, and that forces the real decision to be made up front, in writing, by a human. Do not 'fix' a stuck daemon by widening allow until the wall goes away - decide deliberately which side of the line each capability belongs on.
